# Jiyology Building Construction & Plumbing - Complete Reference

> Professional construction and plumbing contractor based in Soweto, Johannesburg, South Africa. SABS approved, BEE Level 1 compliant (50% black woman owned). Specializing in roofing, plumbing, paving, tiling, painting, ceiling installation, and home renovations for residential, commercial, and industrial clients.

## Company Overview

- [Home](https://www.jiyology.co.za): Main landing page for Jiyology Building Construction & Plumbing. Overview of services, company highlights (SABS approved, BEE Level 1), and calls-to-action for quotes and consultations.
- [About Us](https://www.jiyology.co.za/about): Company founding story -- founded by Vusi Jiya and Lerato Jiya. Details on SABS approved product usage, BEE Level 1 compliance (135% recognition, 50% black woman owned), professional team qualifications, and client-focused service philosophy. Includes mission, vision, and values statements.
- [Contact Us](https://www.jiyology.co.za/contact): Full contact information including phone (011) 931 0157, emails (vusi@jiyology.co.za, vusijiya26@gmail.com), physical address (65 Tsemeli St, Ext 2, Emdeni South, Soweto, 1861). Business hours: Mon-Fri 8:00-17:00, Sat 8:00-13:00, Sun closed. Includes contact form and Google Maps embed with exact coordinates.

## Services

- [All Services Overview](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services): Complete catalog of six core service categories with detailed descriptions, feature lists, and imagery for each service area.
- [Roofing](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services): Roof tile installation, roof sheeting (IBR and corrugated), complete roof erection for new builds, and roof repair services. All materials are SABS approved. Serves residential and commercial clients in Soweto and Johannesburg.
- [Plumbing](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services): Comprehensive plumbing services including routine maintenance, emergency repairs, new installations, pipe replacements, geyser repairs, blocked drain clearing, and quality fixture supply. Available for residential and commercial properties.
- [Paving](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services): Driveway paving, patio and walkway paving, pool deck paving, and existing paving repair and restoration. Uses quality materials with professional finishing. Serves homeowners and businesses in Gauteng.
- [Tiling and Painting](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services): Professional tiling services (floor tiles, wall tiles, ceramic, porcelain) and painting services (interior painting, exterior painting, commercial painting) for private residential, commercial, and industrial clients.
- [Ceiling Installation](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services): New ceiling installation for residential and commercial buildings, ceiling repairs, ceiling replacements, and suspended ceiling systems. Professional workmanship with quality materials.
- [Home Renovation](https://www.jiyology.co.za/services): Complete interior renovation (kitchen remodeling, bathroom renovation, room additions, flooring upgrades) and exterior renovation (facade updates, waterproofing, exterior painting, structural repairs). End-to-end project management from consultation to completion.

- [Project Gallery](https://www.jiyology.co.za/gallery): Visual portfolio of completed construction and plumbing projects. ## Frequently Asked Questions

- What areas does Jiyology serve? Jiyology primarily serves Soweto, Johannesburg, and the greater Gauteng metropolitan area in South Africa, covering approximately a 50km radius from their Emdeni South location.
- Is Jiyology BEE compliant? Yes. Jiyology is a BEE Level One company with 135% BEE recognition. The company is 50% black woman owned and operates as an equal opportunity employer.
- Are materials SABS approved? Yes. Jiyology exclusively uses SABS (South African Bureau of Standards) approved products and materials across all projects, ensuring compliance with South African quality and safety standards.
- How do I request a quote? Clients can request a free quote by calling (011) 931 0157, emailing vusi@jiyology.co.za, or submitting the contact form on the website at https://www.jiyology.co.za/contact.
- What roofing services are offered? Jiyology provides roof tile installation, roof sheeting (IBR and corrugated), complete roof erection for new construction, and roof repair services for existing structures.
- Does Jiyology handle emergency plumbing? Yes. Jiyology offers emergency plumbing services including burst pipe repairs, blocked drains, geyser repairs, and other urgent plumbing issues in the Soweto and Johannesburg area.
- What are the business hours? Monday through Friday: 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Saturday: 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM. Closed on Sundays and public holidays.
- Who founded Jiyology? Jiyology was founded by Vusi Jiya and Lerato Jiya, who are passionate about delivering quality construction and plumbing services to their community.
